_comment: Evidence Layer settings. PROTOTYPE validation limits for software development: none is an official CWC, IMD or hydrological threshold. River plausibility uses the station's QC range from config/river_qc.json (also prototype). Rainfall plausibility caps are physical upper bounds derived from world-record point rainfall (about 305 mm in 1 h; about 1825 mm in 24 h), used only to reject impossible model values, not to judge flood risk.
reference: Prototype assumptions (not approved by any authority).
